Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely narrowed “John Beach” to modern entertainment figures and incorrectly asserted “John Beach (actor) — born October 9, 1967,” contradicting earlier retrieved evidence of an actor John Beach born in 1903 and ignoring older John Beach individuals (e.g., John Elmer Beach, 1900). This mis-disambiguation and misinterpretation of sources led to the wrong comparison (concluding Gordon Persons, 1902, was born first) instead of recognizing a John Beach born earlier than Persons.
